thread:
maria: heads up — linkcheck failing on the site after the nav reorg, a bunch of image anchors 404ing. Full report attached from the bot below.

sam: can you paste the exact failing URL? is it an anchor like `#example-title` or image path?

maria: looks like both. example: `/guides/migration/#upgrading-the-sdk` 404s, and `/assets/diagrams/flow.svg#diagram-3` returns 200 but the page-level anchor doesn't scroll.

jess: hm, we switched some headings from `##` -> `###` during the content trim. That would change generated anchor ids. Might be easiest to add explicit anchors in the markdown or normalize heading levels.

kai: @maria can you drop the linkcheck excerpt? I want to see the rule that flagged it.

maria: sure — here's the snippet the bot posted:

```
LinkCheck: FAIL
  /guides/migration/ -> /guides/migration/#upgrading-the-sdk (HTTP 200) but anchor not found
  /guides/migration/ -> /assets/diagrams/flow.svg#diagram-3 (resource exists)
  /reference/sdk/ -> /reference/sdk/#response-format (anchor changed to #response-format-v2)
```

doc-bot: [linkchecker] run complete — 23 warnings, 7 errors. See: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/linkcheck/1852004321 (truncated)

sam: ok two approaches: (A) revert heading change in the migration guide to preserve anchors, (B) add explicit HTML anchors or `<!-- anchor: upgrading-the-sdk -->` style anchor tokens where needed. I prefer explicit anchors for stability.

jess: i'll open a tiny PR with inline anchors for the broken ones and a short note in the migration guide explaining why anchors are explicit (so future edits don't accidentally break permalinks).

maria: thanks — also can we add a CI check to fail on anchor mismatch for changed headings? saves future churn.

kai: good call. We already have linkcheck but it only reports. We can add a step that compares current linkcheck output to the previous baseline and errors on new anchor-only failures. I'll prototype a small script.

sam: prototype outline: run `linkcheck`, parse lines with `anchor not found`, then compare to `previous_failures.txt` in the artifacts bucket, if new ones -> fail CI. Keeps noise low.

jess: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428 — added explicit anchors and fixed a few relative image refs. PTAL @sam @maria

maria: taking a look now. One nit: the `<!-- anchor: upgrading-the-sdk -->` comment needs to be on its own line immediately before the heading to be stable with the parser.

jess: fixed in 1428 (force-push).

doc-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview-1428--docs.redwood.ai — build passed, linkcheck warnings reduced to 5, errors -> 0. :party_popper:

kai: nice. I'll add the CI comparator in a follow-up — quick script, ~30 LOC.

sam: can we also add a short entry in docs CONTRIBUTING.md about anchor stability and preferred fix patterns? small doc that folks can follow.

maria: yes please. jess can you add that alongside PR 1428 or a tiny follow-up?

jess: adding a short CONTRIBUTING note in a follow-up PR (1429).

maria: thanks all. marking this thread resolved — reopen if we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
